name: Freehand-to-precision snap
looks: A loose hand-drawn squiggle, traced by a small pen glyph at its tip over a faint isometric grid, snaps the instant it finishes into a precise straightened version of the same shape, with angle and length callouts popping in at each vertex.
build: Rough path as a jittered SVG stroke revealed with strokeDashoffset; snap by lerping resampled points from rough to straightened targets on back.out for a slight overshoot; callouts key in staggered 0.05-0.08s after the snap.
sound: A soft pencil scratch under the sketch, a crisp snap hit as it straightens, a tick per callout.
prompt: Show a loose, hand-drawn sketch being traced by a small pen marker, over a faint technical grid. The instant it completes, snap it into a precise, straightened version of the same shape, with measurement callouts popping in at each corner. Let the rough and the precise read as the same idea, before and after.
